g.inkscape:label: Vehicle and skirt frame
g.text: skirt frame: the skirt is fixed to the vehicle and never moves with the floor

g.inkscape:label: Bowl, skirt, wraps
g.text: carbon hoop wrap on the steep band (36 t)
~30 mm mean; floor and band wrap

g.inkscape:label: Gas and spray
g.text: ~4 m deep, ~1 m off the floor

g.inkscape:label: Rim joint detail
g.text: The floor slides like a piston. A rigid joint
would carry a ρcΔv stress wave of 1–3 GPa
within the ~1 ms pulse, so the skirt is not
